invNotFound.en: Not found — it may have been deleted

invCsvCopied.en: File sharing is unavailable here — copied to the clipboard
invCsvCopied.zh: 此处无法发送文件，已复制到剪贴板

invDelLocBody.en: “{name}” and its {boxes} box(es) with {samples} sample(s) will be deleted. Undo is available right after.
invDelLocBody.zh: 将删除「{name}」及其中的 {boxes} 个盒子、{samples} 个样品。删除后可立即撤销。

invDelBoxBody.en: “{name}” and its {samples} sample(s) will be deleted. Undo is available right after.
invDelBoxBody.zh: 将删除「{name}」及其中的 {samples} 个样品。删除后可立即撤销。

invDelSampleBody.en: “{name}” ({pos}) will be deleted. Undo is available right after.
invDelSampleBody.zh: 将删除「{name}」（{pos}）。删除后可立即撤销。

invDelSamplesBody.en: {n} sample(s) will be deleted. Undo is available right after.
invDelSamplesBody.zh: 将删除 {n} 个样品。删除后可立即撤销。

invSamplesEdited.zh: 已批量编辑 {n} 个样品

invGridHint.en: Tap a sample for details · tap an empty position to add one · long-press a sample to edit it.
invGridHint.zh: 点击样品查看详情，点击空位添加样品，长按样品直接编辑。

invSelectHint.en: Tap positions to select · long-press one, then tap another, for a range · tap a row letter or column number for a whole line
invSelectHint.zh: 点击孔位选择 · 长按一个孔位再点另一个可框选区域 · 点行字母或列号选整行 / 整列
